connector.name: ReputeMap
connector.registryDescription: Read and filter your Google Business Profile reviews, get stats, and send review requests.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.reputemap.com over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.reputemap, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer rmk_... — create an API key at https://app.reputemap.com/settings/api-keys (requires a paid plan or trial)
